summary: RPCS3 published 0.0.32-16884 on August 31, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 3 emulator project.

blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.32-16884 on August 31, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (7e7ec7f0381af0f412661b2916e617570fb4c95c575722c8aacfd206e00d492f) and records an archive size of 29559127 bytes, approximately 29.6 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
